note: Aristotle's always-or-usual regularity of natural outcomes is the observation the quinta via starts from. It does not state the restriction to what is best, and Aristotle's own result (ARIST-PHYS-NATURAL-TELEOLOGY) is a transcription over opaque propositions, so nothing is built on it.
